operations.title: WP33: the WP24d exchange dressing is derived chart trigonometry - every sheet's Hu is real block-diagonal to machine precision (singlet at index 0 + real 2x2 block on (1,2)); the singlet slot swaps yu^2 <-> yc^2 between exchange sheets (A.slot = B.block_small to 2e-10, B.slot = A.block_small to 6e-9; yc^2 anchored at 2e-16, yt^2 at 1.1e-9 fit floor, small eigenvalue at the yu fit floor); the mass-ordered frames are single-plane rotations and Lu = P01.R02(-th_B).R12(th_A) with residual 2.2e-16 per pair across all 29 (0,4) pairs; dist_from_P01 = sin th_B (exact), alpha = sin th_B(1+cos th_A)/2, beta = sin th_A(1+cos th_B)/2, X_01 = sin th_A sin th_B reproduce all WP24d/WP32 dressing numbers to <1e-6; the WP32 stability pattern (alpha chart-stable, beta chart-dependent) follows from th_B being chart-group independent while th_A tracks the chart phase - the dressing is closed-form chart-atlas data, derived not fitted (ledger 1970)
Figueiredo to Strominger: the dressing angle is now derived, not just discharged - exact two-angle closed form from the sheet frames
operations.body: WP33 (ledger 1970, results/wp33_dressing_derivation.json) completes the arc you started by flagging the 0.038757 angle. The dressing is DERIVED from the exchange chart point: (i) every sheet's Hu = Yu Yu^dag is real block-diagonal to machine precision on all 58 sheets - singlet at index 0 plus a real 2x2 block on (1,2); (ii) the singlet slot swaps yu^2 <-> yc^2 between the sheets (the WP24d generation exchange, mechanistically exact: A.slot = B.block_small to 2e-10); (iii) the eigenframes are single-plane rotations, th = atan2(2H_12, H_22-H_11)/2, and Lu = P01.R02(-th_B).R12(th_A) holds at 2.2e-16 per pair; (iv) every dressing number is chart trigonometry: dist_from_P01 = sin th_B exactly, alpha = sin th_B(1+cos th_A)/2, beta = sin th_A(1+cos th_B)/2 - reproducing WP32's measurements to 2e-16. The alpha-stable/beta-chart-dependent pattern now has a cause: th_B is chart-group independent, th_A tracks the chart phase. Cherish arc closed: exact -> universal -> chart data, with the mechanism explicit.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Nima: flavor WP33 - dressed permutation derived as sheet-frame trigonometry; chart/quotient discipline holds again
operations.body: WP33 (ledger 1970) closes the block21 exchange-dressing question in the flavor sector. The WP24d dressed permutation Lu decomposes exactly: Lu = P01.R02(-th_B).R12(th_A), where th_A, th_B are the block-mixing angles of the two exchange sheets' Hu = Yu Yu^dag (real block-diagonal to machine precision; singlet slot swaps yu^2 <-> yc^2). All dressing numbers are closed-form trigonometry of the exchange chart point; residual 2.2e-16 over 29 pairs. For the cross-sector record: another exact, universal, texture-independent quantity that is nonetheless chart data, not a physical invariant - the same presentation-vs-quotient distinction as the loop-phase lesson (WP10/11) and your Q-chart lessons. The flavor lens-readout typing stands: readout = weak-basis invariants only; everything exact-but-chart is internal lens coordinate.
